def complete_partial_lines(grid, fill=1):
    """Fill the missing right end of a partial full-width line with `fill` when a complete line of the same color exists."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_colors = {row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1}

            while j < w and row[j] == c: j += 1
            if all(v == 0 or v == c for v in row[:j]) :
                out[i] = [c]*j + [fill]*(w-j)
    return out

def vperiod_fill(grid, fill=1):
    """Cells mismatching their row's vertical-period twin become `fill`."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    best, bestm = None, None
    for p in range(1, h):
        m = sum(1 for r in range(p, h) for j in range(w) if grid[r][j] != grid[r-p][j])

            bestm, best = m, p
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    p = best
    for r in range(p, h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[r][j] != grid[r-p][j]:

    return out
